info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce REST API
info.description:
Primary REST API for accessing Salesforce data including accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, and custom objects. Supports JSON and XML formats with a lightweight request and response framework. Provides CRUD operations on standard and custom sObjects, SOQL/SOSL queries, and access to org metadata.

Contact Support:
 Name: Salesforce Developer Support
